{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: Who are our top 10 customers by revenue?", "sql": "SELECT c.company_name, SUM(i.amount) AS total_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE i.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10"}
